narrative.overview: AgroConnect's visual identity draws inspiration from a sturdy, well-used agricultural field notebook. Built primarily for small agricultural producers operating outdoors under direct sunlight and variable weather, the interface eschews cold neon palettes, artificial gradients, and fragile micro-interactions. In their place, it presents a grounded, tactile atmosphere defined by warm earth tones, generous spacing, and deep-contrast typographic clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Agrarian Palette: Earthy terracotta, warm sand gold, and toasted taupe resting on a calm parchment background.
Tonal Layering with Crisp Borders: Flat-by-default surfaces where depth is established through subtle background shifts and crisp outlines, never muddy drop shadows.
Field-Ready Ergonomics: Minimum 48×48 dp touch targets designed for comfortable one-handed thumb interaction outdoors.
Dual-Signal Communication: Every status, alert, and diagnostic indicator pairs semantic color with an unambiguous icon and explicit textual label.

rules.name: The Daylight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Primary numbers, headlines, and critical telemetry values must always use Coffee Brown (#382719) or Contrast White (#FFFFFF). Low-contrast grays or faded pastels are forbidden for primary metrics to ensure legibility under midday sunlight.

rules.name: The Dual-Signal Rule
rules.body: Status indicators and alerts must never rely on color alone. Every warning, error, or online state must pair its semantic color with a dedicated icon and explicit text label.

rules.name: The Fixed Ratio Rule
rules.body: Font sizes and line heights are strictly mapped to predefined scale tokens. Arbitrary fontSize numbers must not be declared in individual component styles.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is established purely through tonal layering and crisp 1px borders (#D6C3A5), never heavy or fuzzy drop shadows. Surface cards (#FFFBF5) rest cleanly on the parchment background (#EAD9C1), maintaining a natural, paper-and-binder aesthetic.

dos: Do maintain a minimum 48×48 dp touch target for all interactive elements and buttons.
Do use the parchment background (#EAD9C1) for screens and off-white (#FFFBF5) for cards and inputs.
Do accompany every status color with a descriptive icon and plain-language text label.
Do test text readability in outdoor sunlight by verifying high contrast against Coffee Brown (#382719).
Do use RefreshControl with Terracotta tint (#C46B38) for pull-to-refresh interactions.
donts: Don't add artificial drop shadows, blurred glows, or skeuomorphic bevels to cards.
Don't use pure black (#000000) or cold slate grays for text; use Coffee Brown (#382719) and Muted Earth (#6B5844).
Don't rely on color alone to communicate sensor health, connection dropouts, or critical alerts.
Don't stack Floating Action Buttons or create complex nested swipe gestures that conflict with Android system Back.
Don't hardcode raw font sizes or colors in component styles; always reference colors, spacing, and typography tokens.
